payload.evidence_against: T041's legal inverse-pseudo-MSE arbitration scores 11.154148 versus 9.276142 for the fixed E011/PF reference, wins 0/5 folds and 6/25 cells, has mean rank Spearman 0.16, and is beaten by both corrupted routing controls. Projected serial runtime is 10.93 hours.
payload.evidence_for: The frozen seven-candidate component oracle reaches 5.883054 on the same 100 wells, with PF, stable HMM, edge HMM, E011, and all three fixed blends selected across different wells.
payload.next_test: Do not retune pseudo-cuts, floors, temperatures, or direct arbitration. Use T042 to test materially different full-path disagreement and posterior-state diagnostics under whole-well cross-fitting.
payload.statement: Visible-prefix self-verification can identify which public-core trajectory tracker is reliable for each well strongly enough to improve the 50/50 E011–PF baseline and preserve a sub-6 component oracle.
payload.title: Public-core tracker arbitration transfers robustly
